# Odyssey Solutions

> Odyssey Solutions provides on-site IT support across Greater Houston and
> remote support where the setup allows it. Services include managed IT,
> Microsoft 365, cybersecurity, backups, vendor coordination, healthcare and
> dental IT, websites, workflow tools, and technology projects.

## Important boundaries

Odyssey provides IT services and educational guidance, not legal advice. No
checklist, assessment, training program, or IT provider can guarantee HIPAA
compliance. Do not submit protected health information,
passwords, patient records, or other sensitive data through public website
forms.
